author: BipolarGaming
quote: When I spent $160 on GTA 6 I thought I was getting the newest release of Grand theft auto.. this is by far the worst GTA they have made. This should have been called Red Redemption 3 which just Red Dead Redemption set in modern days. The main character even looks and sounds like Arthur! Add a scar and 30 years on him and some long hair and it will be Arthur. They have added most of the features from Red Dead Redemption, and even the movement feels like RDR. This is an extreme disappointment and I have waited 13 years for them just to add the same vehicles to the game, the same long process to earn tiny bits of money and then just recycling most features from RDR. The game is boring, the characters are not appealing at all, the gameplay is mellow and child-friendly, and if I wanted to play RDR I would have played that instead! This game just shows you the direction that Rockstar is going now, They have run out of ideas after GTA 5 and they will never be able to make a better game than that. They are moving away from their original gameplay and becoming a more mainstream game like all the rest. Instead of a upgrade from GTA 5, they now want us to play house. If i wanted a wife and kids and upgrading my house, I would play the sims. This is supposed to be GTA, what a letdown and Rockstar has lost a lot of respect for hyping this game so much and then supply this
